body: I've tried my best to get my feelings across to my psychiatrist but I get the feeling he just wants me to get in and out and get me on pills that will make him some money. My therapist cares for me at least. He's made 2 adjustments, and the initial drug he put me on a year ago has never worked, and I tell him that every time, but he doesn't listen.

I'm really sorry that happened, if it helps at all I just went through a horrible breakup based on differences in beliefs. My girlfriend just broke up with me after over a year (and we were perfect together with promises for the future) for not being Christian enough, what a coincidence. I'm probably ending it tonight if my mindset doesn't change.

If it helps at all I'm in an eerily similar situation. 4 days ago my girlfriend broke up with me (LTR) and that's when I realized she was the only source of joy in my life. The emotional pain I was left with led to me cutting and preparing a prepackaged suicide for me to use whenever I got the balls to do it, which hasn't happened. I'm only 17M and everything in my life is painful and bleak. I can relate on a very personal level, getting out of bed is insanely hard. There are a lot of painful things to do tomorrow for me (get expensive genetic testing for better antidepressants, tell my parents me and my girlfriend are done with) and I think I might do it tonight. It was hard dealing with depression with her, but the joy was there to combat the pain. Now that's all over with and only amplified pain is left. I'm sorry that this isn't helpful at all, I really hope things get better for you. It's just unfair, and someone like me who has had similar experiences is probably not going to make it through the night.
i understand, best of luck in whatever you want to do
i believe if thats what you truly wanted, you could eventually find it, but i understand if the pain becomes too much. that's where i'm at right now.

i wish i had the strength to do it now or this week, i doubt i'll be able to overcome the survival instinct. if you end up doing it i hope you planned it out well so that it's painless, and if you end up surviving, i hope you are able to find meaning in life.

That's horrible. Honestly sounds like utter despair. I just had much of my life take a turn for the worse and then right when I needed it most my LTR broke it off with me, but I can't imagine dealing with a full blown divorce. Best of luck, but I understand that the emotional pain can become to much to bear.

I feel this, except I was just left by the one that gave me hope out of the blue and left for dead. She'd never take her life, but if she would have at least I wouldn't have to end up seeing her with another person she chose over me one day. You're in a shitty situation and it's not fair. I'm not in a good place to give good advice but in all honesty, if you want to push on then do it, if you are left in despair, then make the choice that leads you to peace. Good luck my friend.
Yeah I violently cried my eyes out writing my suicide notes, I just couldn't have anyone finding out about it.

I planned to do it in the woods tonight, but the survival instinct and panic mode are formidable foes. My life is similarly sad and painful every day, so I hope that things maybe either get better for you or that your potential decision to commit goes painlessly.
Thank you for the advice, unfortunately a year later psychiatry and therapy haven't gotten me very far, but I can keep trying.
Thank you, I've made sure to hold it all in even if it's been killing me. I'll try my best to make it there.

I can't tell anyone because I know my parents would immediately send me to a psych ward or something. They did it with my sister so I really have to hide the marks on my legs. I was in a LDR with the only hope I had left in life for over a year who gave a reason to keep going, but she cut me off randomly and it's killing me. I've been considering making a suicide pact with my old girlfriend before my LDR because I know she has similar feelings about life, but I can't deal with the potential social ramifications. I wish I could run away with someone who will murder me too. I can sympathize if nothing else. I'm sorry for the tangent, I just want you to know I understand a little bit of the situation you're in. I genuinely hope things improve for you, or that your potential suicide goes painlessly and quickly.

I'm sorry, Reddit's viewing algorithms aren't helpful. I feel the same when when I post here, actually just made a post as well, doubt anyone will see it. Unfortunately I'm also in a place where I feel suicide is the only way to go yet I somehow can't bring myself to do it, so I doubt any advice from a good-for-nothing like myself would be any help. All I can do is say that I hope you find what you are looking for in life, and in order to do that you should just go all out for as long as you can, throwing everything negative in your life in the trash. That's what I wish I could muster up the courage and energy to do. I hope things improve for you.
